title: 第十九章   战蓝湘
content_zh:
望着战台之上的靓丽女子，琼霄有些无语，在战台之上的女子周身散发着强大的星力，看样子这位女子应该是踏入了玄星境初期境界。“你是最后的考官？”琼霄试探着问道，此刻的琼霄琼霄能感觉的到战台上的女子有多么棘手。

    战台之上的女子紧盯着琼霄，旋即面无表情的说道：“我叫蓝湘，是星辰学院的学生，也是你最后一关的守护者，由于你前两关测试结果表现不错，学院老师特地让我来作为你最后的考官！”

    “额，这个是不是有点太过严格了？”琼霄看着蓝湘有些无语的说道。

    蓝湘闻言黛眉皱了起来，他盯着琼霄冷声道：“要么战，要么放弃！我可不想浪费时间！决定好没有！”

    闻言，琼霄无奈的笑了笑，看来他要放手一搏了，旋即缓缓的握紧了双手对着战台上的蓝湘开口道：“既然已经来到了最后一关，我怎么会放弃！再说了，放弃可不是我的习惯！”

    听到琼霄的决定，蓝湘眉头稍微舒展了一下，紧紧盯着琼霄随即说道：“有魄力，这才像男子汉，仅凭**境中期的实力就敢接受测试，不过我丑话说在前面，一旦挑战失败，那么你将失去进入星辰学院的资格！”

    “既然已经决定我就不会轻易放弃！蓝湘学姐请赐教！”

    就在他的声音刚落的瞬间，他的身体已经是暴掠而出，一股与**境中期一样气势瞬间爆发，直冲蓝湘而来。

    蓝湘冷笑着，既不闪也不避，娇躯之上，强横的星力又如火山爆发一般，直接将琼霄震的倒射出去！

    被震射而出的琼霄半跪在地上，双手着地，双脚在战台上划出了数丈长的痕迹。

    **境中期的与玄星境初期的差距，实在太过巨大！

    “就这么点本事？看来那几个老头看走眼了啊！”

    蓝湘紧盯着有些狼狈的琼霄道：“拿出你所有的本事吧，要不然你连出手的机会都没有了！”

    “穿风刺！”

    琼霄没有丝毫的客气，那把周身弥漫着狂暴的星力重剑在琼霄手中快速的刺了出去，瞬间星力化成一把与重剑相当大小的星力巨剑，那剑身之上，闪耀若有若无的精光，便对着蓝湘刺了过去。

    面对着这种对手，寻常攻击肯定难以取得效果，所以他必须倾尽全力出手！

    “还算有点本事！”蓝湘望着携带周身着狂暴星力的剑身，快速朝她刺来，这才冷吭一声，玉手缓缓伸直，随即掌心上迅速形成了一把星力长枪，旋即脚尖轻轻一点地，身形便朝着剑身暴掠而去。

    “狂龙出击！”冰冷的低喝声从蓝湘口中传出，她玉臂一震，那星力长枪光芒爆射，迅速形成了一条长龙，极速的朝着剑身而去，那条长龙宛如真是存在一般，一阵龙吟声，响彻战台，最后硬生生的撞在了剑身之上。

    轰！

    一股惊人的星力波动瞬间弥漫开来，连空气都被震的发出噼里啪啦的声响。

    “哼！”一声娇响，蓝湘体内星力瞬间爆发来。

    嘭！

    琼霄的攻击瞬间破碎开来，一条耀眼的长龙自那剑身穿出，瞬间冲向琼霄。

    “三段劈！”一阵低吼声从琼霄喉咙中发出，双手握住重剑，而后重重星力进入重剑之中随着重剑举过琼霄头顶，最后一剑劈了下去，那携带着重重攻势的三段劈最终劈在了长龙身上。
content_en:
Looking at the beautiful woman on the battle platform, Qiong Xiao was speechless. The woman on the battle platform exuded powerful star power. It seemed that this woman had entered the early stage of the Xuanxing Realm."Are you the final examiner?" Qiong Xiao asked tentatively. At this moment, Qiong Xiao could feel how troublesome the woman on the battlefield was.

The woman on the battlefield stared at Qiong Xiao, and then said expressionlessly: "My name is Lan Xiang, I am a student of Xingchen Academy, and I am also the guardian of your last level. Since you performed well in the first two levels of the test, the college teacher specially asked me to be your final examiner!"

"Um, isn't this a little too strict?" Qiong Xiao looked at Lan Xiang and said speechlessly.

Lan Xiang frowned when he heard this. He stared at Qiong Xiao and said coldly: "Either fight or give up! I don't want to waste time! Have you decided yet?"

Hearing this, Qiong Xiao smiled helplessly. It seemed that he was about to give it a try. Then he slowly clenched his hands and said to Lan Xiang on the battlefield: "Since we have reached the last level, how could I give up! Besides, giving up is not my habit!"

Hearing Qiong Xiao's decision, Lan Xiang relaxed his brows slightly, stared at Qiong Xiao closely, and then said: "You are courageous. This is like a man. You dare to accept the test based on your strength in the middle stage of the Golden Realm. But I will say something ugly in front of you. Once you fail the challenge, you will lose the qualification to enter the Star Academy!"

"Now that I've decided, I won't give up easily! Senior Lan Xiang, please enlighten me!"

The moment his voice fell, his body rushed out violently, and an aura similar to the one in the middle stage of the ** realm burst out in an instant, heading straight towards Lan Xiang.

Lan Xiang sneered, neither dodging nor dodging. On his delicate body, the powerful star power erupted like a volcano, directly shooting Qiong Xiao backwards!

Qiong Xiao, who was ejected from the shock, was half-kneeling on the ground, with his hands on the ground, and his feet left traces several feet long on the battlefield.

The gap between the middle stage of ** realm and the early stage of Xuanxing realm is too huge!

"Is that all you have? It seems that those old men have made a mistake!"

Lan Xiang stared at the embarrassed Qiong Xiao and said, "Use all your skills, otherwise you won't even have a chance to take action!"

"Piercing the Wind!"

Qiong Xiao was not polite at all, and the star power epee filled with violence was thrust out quickly in Qiong Xiao's hand. In an instant, the star power turned into a star power giant sword that was about the same size as the epee. On the blade of the sword, there was a faint light shining, and it stabbed at Lan Xiang.

Facing this kind of opponent, it would be difficult for ordinary attacks to be effective, so he must use all his strength to attack!

"It's quite capable!" Lan Xiang looked at the sword that was carrying violent star power and stabbed at her quickly. Then he said coldly, slowly straightened his jade hand, and then a star power spear quickly formed on the palm of his hand. Then with a tap of his toes, his figure rushed towards the sword.

"Crazy dragon attacks!" A cold low voice came from Lan Xiang's mouth. Her jade arms shook, and the star power spear burst out with light, quickly forming a long dragon and heading towards the sword body at an extremely fast speed. The long dragon seemed to really exist. A dragon roar resounded through the battlefield, and finally hit the sword body hard.

boom!

An astonishing fluctuation of star power spread instantly, and even the air was shaken to make a crackling sound.

"Hmph!" With a sweet sound, the star power in Lan Xiang's body burst out instantly.

Bang!

Qiong Xiao's attack shattered instantly, and a dazzling long dragon emerged from the sword and rushed towards Qiong Xiao.

"Three-stage chop!" A low roar came from Qiong Xiao's throat. He held the heavy sword with both hands, and then a lot of star power entered the heavy sword. As the heavy sword was raised above Qiong Xiao's head, the last sword struck down. The three-stage chop carrying a heavy offensive finally struck Changlong.
